To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the CD4 count in PTB patients was lower than that of healthy controls, and that initiation of ART during TB treatment is the strongest factor associated with an increase in CD4 levels during TB treatment.
CD4 levels were lower in HIV-infected TB patients than in non-HIV infected TB patients.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamics of CD4 cell counts in pulmonary TB patients with or without HIV co-infections.
the interaction of HIV and TB in the immune response.
understanding the interaction of TB and HIV on CD4 counts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

HIV and TB co-infection are associated with lower CD4 counts at diagnosis, that the CD4 counts do not increase significantly during TB treatment and that initiation of ART is associated with increase in CD4 count during TB treatment.

the increase in CD4 levels observed after two months of TB treatment in PTB patients is irrespective of HIV status, and initiation of ART during TB treatment is the strongest factor associated with CD4 increase in TB patients.
the interaction of HIV and TB on CD4 levels is complex and has to be considered in a longitudinal manner, and not in a single point of time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CD4 levels were lower in TB patients with or without HIV co-infections.
HIV and tuberculosis (PTB) are major public health problems in Tanzania.
HIV and tuberculosis (PTB) have a negative interaction on CD4 counts in the first months after diagnosis, and that this negative interaction is more pronounced in patients not receiving ART.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CD4 count is not a good indicator of the immune response in TB patients.
the CD4 count in TB patients with HIV is not affected by the TB treatment.
the increase of CD4 cells observed in PTB patients is acquired after two months of treatment and is independent of HIV status.
